subject: Proceed with infra replacement: open req + interview panel scheduling
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara@harbortalent.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@example.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate slate + request to open replacement headcount for Infra Eng (Priya Shah)

Diego —

Quick note from Harbor: we have Priya Shah (ex-Platform at Nimbus) interested in the infra replacement role you briefed us on. Attached is a short slate (1-pager) and Priya's availability for the next two weeks. Can you confirm whether we should proceed to open the req so we can lock the panel and book interviews?

Key details inline:
- Candidate: Priya Shah — senior infra engineer, distributed systems, 6 yrs at Nimbus
- Target band: L4-L5 (flexible)
- Availability: 2027-05-17 to 2027-05-21 (mornings PDT)
- Attachments: candidate_slate_Priya_Shah.pdf, resume

If you give the greenlight, we'll:
1) Ask Priya to pick slots;
2) Send calendar holds for panel (you + hiring mgr + interviewers);
3) Share short tech screen + take-home plan.

Thanks — Sara
Harbor Talent

--
Attachment: candidate_slate_Priya_Shah.pdf (1 page — summary, top projects, references)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Klein <sara@harbortalent.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate slate + request to open replacement headcount for Infra Eng (Priya Shah)

Lauren / Mina —

Looping you both to request authorization to open the headcount for an infra replacement (role is a backfill for Diego's IC headcount). Sara submitted a good first slate (attached). I need two quick confirmations to proceed:

1) Budget & band: are we OK to post at L4 (target) with flexibility to L5 for strong match? I've attached the suggested comp band.
2) Interview panel approval: I'd like to lock the panel below if you approve —
   - Diego Fernandez (hiring manager) — onsite system design
   - Lauren Bishop (team lead) — code & systems review
   - Mina Haddad (platform reliability) — reliability & postmortem discussion

If both OK, I'll ask Sara to open the req + schedule initial phone screen for 2027-05-17 morning slots.

Notes: this is a backfill after Erin's internal transfer; we have approval from Eng head for headcount but need official gating from People/Finance for posting.

Thanks,
Diego
Engineering Manager, Inference Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: candidate_slate_Priya_Shah.pdf, comp_band_infra_team.xlsx, JD_infra_engineer_v3.md
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate slate + request to open replacement headcount for Infra Eng (Priya Shah)

Diego —

I reviewed the slate and Priya looks like a solid match. Approve for panel and scheduling. A couple asks before we post:

- Please confirm the hiring rubric we discussed (system design + debugging exercise + infra coding sample). I want the rubrics attached to the JD when it goes to People.
- Compensation: comp_band_infra_team.xlsx looks OK but confirm total comp ceiling for L5 (we shouldn't exceed the cap without VP sign-off).
- Panel scheduling: pref 17th or 19th mornings PDT; keep 45/60 minute slots.

Once Mina confirms the gate from People/Finance, greenlight from my side.

Thanks —
Lauren
Staff Engineer, Inference Infra

Diego / Lauren —

OK to proceed with opening the req and scheduling the panel. Conditions and next steps:

1) Finance has confirmed headcount capacity against the org chart but requires a code: FIN-ENG-2027-23 to be applied on the posting. I'll loop People Ops to add the code and ensure comp band review.
2) People Ops wants the interview rubric + JD (please attach JD_infra_engineer_v3.md to the posting).
3) Keep initial screen to 30 minutes (phone), then 60 for onsite. If Priya is only available mornings, use standard scoring and ask for a short home task post-screen if we need deeper signal.

Lauren — please confirm the L5 ceiling; if you expect to exceed the band, escalate to VP Eng.

Diego — once you confirm you want me to apply FIN-ENG-2027-23, I'll kick People Ops and Finance.

Signed —
Mina Haddad
Director, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
